protocol_type: Streaming serial audio bus; no command/opcode protocol. Continuous clock + word-select + serial data.

channels.name: SCK
channels.description: Continuous Serial Clock. Drives bit rate (one rising edge per data bit).

channels.name: WS
channels.description: Word Select. 0 = channel 1 (left); 1 = channel 2 (right). Changes one clock period before MSB.

channels.name: SD
channels.description: Serial Data. MSB-first two's complement; latched by receiver on leading edge of SCK.

valid_ready_handshake_rules: There is no handshake / ACK / framing — I2S is a continuous streaming bus.
Synchronization is purely by SCK + WS edges; the transmitter must hold SD valid through the leading edge of SCK so the receiver can latch.
WS edge serves as the channel-boundary marker: WS transition + 1 SCK period later = MSB of next word.

frame_format.word_layout: MSB-first; word length implementation-defined; transmitter sends MSB first, then bit n-1, ..., LSB.
frame_format.channel_layout: Two channels time-multiplexed: WS=0 → channel 1 (left); WS=1 → channel 2 (right).
frame_format.channel_boundary: WS transition (either direction) marks the boundary; the MSB of the next word is sent on the SCK period following the WS transition.
frame_format.word_length_handling: Mismatched word lengths: transmitter zero-pads LSBs (if shorter than system width); receiver truncates LSBs (if narrower than transmitted).
